items.claim: OpenAI says generation latency can fall by as much as 50% versus Images 2.0.
items.note: IT Home reports that OpenAI announced a maximum 50% reduction, but the supplied official OpenAI excerpt does not contain the latency figure. The evidence package supports attribution to IT Home, not a directly evidenced statement by OpenAI.

claim_check.reason: All other event-specific claims, quotations, roles, source-level caveats, and explicitly conditional inferences are supported or appropriately hedged by the supplied evidence. No claim says both companies confirmed anything.

evidence_caveats: 没有独立、可复现的 Images 2.0 与 2.5 同任务性能和编辑稳定性对照。
局部评论式编辑的官方原页摘录不完整；现有直接官方证据足以支撑编辑方向，但不宜扩展为具体交互细节的确定承诺。
所有社区测试均应按个人经验处理，不能推广为普遍性能事实。
微信来源未实际抓取成功，不能引用或用于补强。
API 型号、价格、可用计划和限制没有对应的完整官方文档证据，文章不应纳入这些事实。
seo_title: GPT Image 2.5 Makes AI Art Revision-Ready
seo_summary: GPT Image 2.5 shifts AI image work from one-shot generation to iterative editing with sketches, references, and local comments.

cover.alt: A loose blue line reshapes one small corner of an otherwise intact black-and-ivory editorial illustration, with muted vermilion accents.
cover.caption: The useful image model is not the one that makes a first draft; it is the one that lets the picture remain itself while a person changes their mind.

images.alt: A loose blue line reshapes one small corner of an otherwise intact black-and-ivory editorial illustration, with muted vermilion accents.
images.caption: The useful image model is not the one that makes a first draft; it is the one that lets the picture remain itself while a person changes their mind.

images.alt: A red coffee cup sits on a table while the tabletop texture, window light, and nearby hand visibly change around it.
images.caption: A local edit that moves everything else is not precision—it is a restart disguised as success.

images.alt: A rough blue circle surrounds a small flaw in a finished picture, and the circled area is neatly repaired.
images.caption: When the problem is visual, a crooked circle can be more exact than a perfect sentence.

images.alt: A portrait and surrounding scene remain aligned while one small circled area appears in three layered changed positions.
images.caption: The test is not whether one mark can move; it is whether everything that should stay still does.
